New Image of Kratos in God of War Laufey Sparks Questions - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:

Sony has revealed a new image from the upcoming God of War Laufey, featuring Kratos. While Kratos appeared briefly in the game's extended gameplay trailer, this screenshot places Kratos and Laufey in what appears to be ancient Greece, from a time before they even met. Not much is known about the game's story and setting, aside from Laufey waking up in the Everywhen after being cremated by Kratos in the 2018 game. In entertainment news, Spider-Man: Homecoming director Jon Watts has been tapped by Disney to helm the first in a new Star Wars trilogy from writer Simon Kinberg. Watts already has experience with Star Wars, co-creating the Goonies-esque Disney+ series, Skeleton Crew. And finally, Avengers: Endgame Encore assembled an impressive $86 million global box office haul in its first re-release. That's on top of the already massive $2.88 billion the movie has already made since its first debut in 2019.

Street Fighter - Official 'Ken vs Ryu' Behind the Scenes
Sworn brothers. Greatest rivals. Join director Kitao Sakurai, stars Andrew Koji (Ryu) and Noah Centineo (Ken) for a behind-the-scenes look at the upcoming Street Fighter movie and the relationship between these two iconic characters. Street Fighter also stars Joe “Roman Reigns” Anoai as Akuma, David Dastmalchian as M. Bison, Cody Rhodes as Guile, Andrew Schulz as Dan Hibiki, Orville Peck as Vega, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson as Balrog, Jason Momoa as Blanka, Eric André as Don Sauvage, Vidyut Jammwal as Dhalsim, Olivier Richters as Zangief, Hirooki Goto as E. Honda, Rayna Vallandingham as Juli, and Alexander Volkanovski as Joe. 

Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

The film is directed by Kitao Sakurai and produced by Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Jason Momoa, Takayuki Nakayama, and Stefan Makhoul. JJ Hook, Jay Ashenfelter, Kenzo Tsujimoto, and Haruhiro Tsujimoto serve as executive producers. The story is by Dalan Musson and Gary Dauberman. The screenplay is by Kitao Sakurai and T.J. Fixman.

Street Fighter opens in theaters on October 16, 2026.

text:
Minecraft Dungeons 2 Review
Minecraft Dungeons 2 reviewed by Travis Northup on Xbox Series X, also available on PC, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch.

"Minecraft Dungeons 2 is a shallow ARPG that offers a few evenings of mindless dungeon delving fun, but not much beyond that. Aside from the new Sift realm, which has some cool new ideas and creatures to admire as you and your friends carve your way through it, there’s just not much to make this sequel stand out. It makes poor use of Minecraft’s iconic world, feeling like little more than a skin slapped onto a generic Diablo-like, with a barebones story and skin-deep hack-and-slash combat. This low-stakes action isn’t a bad way to pass the time, especially if you’re intimidated by the hilariously crunchy menus and buildcrafting of more serious ARPGs, but there also aren’t a ton of compelling reasons to play this one beyond that."

text:
The Witcher 3 Remastered - Switch 2 Vs PC Graphics Comparison
After what feels like forever, the remastered edition of Witcher 3 is finally here and it definitely packs a punch. 
From the dozens of quality of life upgrades, to a completely revamped combat system, graphic overhaul, and new expansion on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to dive back into the world of The Witcher, or check it out for the first time. In this video were going to take a look at The Witcher 3 Remastered running on a PC with a 5090 with all the specs bumped up to the max, alongside the Switch 2 port that is shockingly…but also at this point when it comes to Switch 2 ports, not too surprising, because it looks outstanding. 
The Switch 2 port runs at a pretty stable 30-40fps in both handheld and docked modes. While handheld the game has a 720p resolution and while docked it’s 1080p. There is no ray tracing and the switch 2 version also has some exclusive features such as touch screen support, gyro aiming if you’re into that,  and Joy-Con mouse control. Narrated and Produced by Nick Maillet.
